prasadams.description: Sacred sweet offering blessed at the altar of Goddess Mahakali. Traditionally prepared by designated temple cooks utilizing pure cow ghee, gram flour (besan), cardamom powder, and refined sugar.

prasadams.description: Traditional savory prasadam made of parboiled rice infused with fresh tamarind paste, roasted peanuts, curry leaves, green chilies, mustard seeds, and turmeric powder.
Highly revered deep-red vermilion powder placed directly at the feet of the historic wooden deity idol during daily Archana rituals, distributed to devotees as a vital token of protection.
